//schema: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: a PromQL condition uses conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage with a 'query' whose own comparison (> 0.2) is the threshold, plus 'duration' (the for-clause) and 'evaluationInterval'. There is no thresholdValue/comparison here — that pair belongs to conditionThreshold, a different condition type. Confirm the field names against a real 'gcloud alpha monitoring policies create' before trusting.

documentation.content: The execute_tool.duration error ratio has been above 20% for 5 minutes. A dependency the agent calls is failing; the invocation may still be reporting success (invoke_agent error ratio stays 0), so users are getting turns that complete without an answer. See tutorial page 3.3 for the tool-vs-invocation split and 3.7 for the task-outcome counter.
